title: SEG Witnesses Edge
description: Schema for a Witnesses edge in the Safety Evidence Graph. Direction: TestOutcome → Implementation. Created automatically by the CI pipeline. Sink edge: no suspicion propagation, no edgeHash, no linkState. The verification mechanism for this edge is the seg:repoBSha field stored on the TestOutcome node — not a field on the edge itself. At proof generation time, the recorded seg:repoBSha is compared against the current HEAD of repo B; a mismatch marks the outcome stale (it ran against a different implementation state than current) and the outcome is discarded from the proof and recorded in the CoverageReport. Node hashes are never stored in the live node records in repo G — they are recomputed transiently. An auditor independently re-establishes the implementation state by rerunning the implementation extractor at the recorded seg:repoBSha and comparing the resulting node hashes against the nodeManifest sealed in the DesignConsistencyProof.

seg:from.description: IRI of the TestOutcome node — the one that witnesses.

seg:to.description: IRI of the Implementation node — the one being witnessed. Freshness of this binding (recorded seg:repoBSha vs current repo B HEAD) is checked at proof generation time; auditor-side hash recomputation is verified against the DesignConsistencyProof nodeManifest.
